# Migibio (Guangzhou Magic Biotech) — POCT Veterinary Diagnostics
> **Official B2B Website:** https://migibio.com
> **Company:** Guangzhou Magic Biotech Co., Ltd. (brand: Migibio)
> **Founded:** November 2017 · Guangzhou Science City, China
> **Core Technology:** Fluorescence Immunochromatographic Technology (FICT)
> **Certifications:** ISO9001, GMP · 30 patents · exported to 30+ countries
## About
Migibio is an ISO9001/GMP-certified manufacturer of point-of-care (POCT) veterinary diagnostic equipment and fluorescence immunochromatographic test reagents. The company produces single-channel (FIA680) and multi-channel (FIA880) immunofluorescence analyzers plus a broad panel of quantitative rapid test kits for canine and feline infectious disease, hormones, inflammatory markers, and kidney/cardiac biomarkers.
## Equipment (Analyzers)
- [FIA680](https://migibio.com/equipment/FIA680/): Migibio FIA680 — single-channel veterinary immunofluorescence quantitative analyzer for POCT diagnostics. Results in 3–1
- [FIA880](https://migibio.com/equipment/FIA880/): Migibio FIA880 — six-channel veterinary immunofluorescence quantitative analyzer for high-throughput labs. Simultaneous
